text:
alex_support: Heads-up — customer morgan@example.com reports giftcode GFT-7X9Q rejected as 'invalid/expired' right after they reset their password. They used it on web checkout. Screenshot attached: https://rwd.example/s/abc
jess_billing: Can you paste the raw code and the account email? I'll look up the redemption log.
alex_support: Code: GFT-7X9Q. Email: morgan+test@example.com (they said they reset pw and maybe merged aliases). They said code worked earlier but now shows invalid.
lee_eng: :eyes: can you grab the /redemptions API logs + user_id from when they tried to redeem? Also last auth event timestamp.
alex_support: Pasting copy of user message: 'I added the gift code during checkout, it immediately failed with "Invalid or expired code". I just reset my password seconds before this happened.' Screenshot: https://rwd.example/s/abc
alex_support: Got logs from payments: attempt at 2147999900 returned 410 InvalidOrExpired. Redemption record: redemption_id null, reason=CODE_STATE=active, but user_id mismatch. Looks like service returned invalid because principal in cache != db.
lee_eng: Hmm. I see an identity-merge event for morgan at 2147999700 (password_reset triggered account merge with former SSO alias). When we merge accounts we mark old_principal as deprecated; our redemption cache key uses legacy_principal_id for a short TTL and may cause the code-service to think the code was already claimed or invalid. This is an eventual consistency bug.
jess_billing: So code is actually still active in DB? Can we reapply credit manually?
lee_eng: Yes DB shows promo GFT-7X9Q status=active, unused. But the gateway checks a cache keyed by canonical_principal that was updated by the merge. Short term fix: flush promo-cache for that code and for the two user principal ids, then retry redemption.
alex_support: Can we do cache flush + ask customer to retry? If not, manual credit.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: rolled back cache patch candidate at 2147999800 — no incidents.
lee_eng: I can flush specific cache keys now. Alex — please confirm customer's current canonical user id: morgan@ -> user_id: U12345. Also ask them to sign out/in and try again in 5 mins.
alex_support: Reached out to customer with steps: sign out, sign back in, attempt apply again. If still fails we'll issue manual credit. ETA to customer: 30m.
alex_support: Customer tried after signout/signin — still fails, same error (they sent screenshot).
lee_eng: Ok flushing cache keys for GFT-7X9Q and U12345... flushed. Ask them to retry.
alex_support: Customer retried and it worked — code applied and they confirmed credit. Closing after manual verification.
jess_billing: I'll note manual intervention (cache flush) and flag this for a bug ticket against identity-merge->promo-cache invalidation.
alex_support: Filed BUG-9876. Customer notified and we reissued nothing. Marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
